experiment_cards.title: Example 12 / SEQ17: receptor cAMP potency under FBS/BSA conditions

experiment_cards.species_or_cell: Engineered HEK-293 cells expressing human receptors; no patient samples

source_discrepancies.detail: Reported native-control EC50 values 0.0125/0.133/0.0591 nM are below the printed native range lower bound 448 pM (0.448 nM). Cause is unexplained; printed units are not repaired. Example12 values lie within its separately stated example range.

experiment_cards.interpretation_limit: Reported engineered-cell potency supports a mechanism hypothesis only. It does not establish clinical efficacy, patient exposure, safety, trial success probability or patent rights. Table4 casein-condition values, Table2 binding Ki and Example1 mouse values are excluded from this card.

experiment_cards.title: Example 12 / SEQ17: functional cAMP potency in 0.1% casein (Table 4)
experiment_cards.text_sha256_scope: Existing patent_evidence.canonical_sha256(OCR text): NFC-normalized JSON string, not raw text bytes
experiment_cards.experiment_system: Functional cAMP response measured by homogeneous time-resolved fluorescence in HEK293 cells expressing human GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors, using 0.1% casein as nonspecific blocker instead of serum albumin.
experiment_cards.species_or_cell: HEK293 human-receptor cell assays; no patient samples or clinical outcome.

sample_size.unit_definition: The table reports n; independent biological versus technical repeats, independent days and preparations are not specified for this additional assay.

dose.missingness_basis: The additional Table 4 methods do not explicitly report these values. Table 3 values are not inherited.

assay_conditions.quantification: Intracellular cAMP extrapolated from standard curve; percent stimulation normalized to minimum buffer-only and maximum concentration of each control ligand; four-parameter nonlinear fit with variable slope (Genedata Screener 13).
assay_conditions.patent_stated_blocker_rationale: Patent states that casein does not interact with fatty acid moieties. This is an author explanation, not a separately verified interaction experiment in this card.

experiment_cards.comparator: Buffer-only minimum and maximal concentration of each control ligand for normalization. Table 4 rows are labeled hGcg, hGIP amide and gGLP-1 amide as printed; gGLP-1 is retained as an unresolved source naming ambiguity. Control summaries are not established as contemporaneous paired comparisons to Example 12.
experiment_cards.endpoint: Functional cAMP EC50 per human receptor assay under the 0.1% casein condition.
experiment_cards.unit: nM for EC50 and SEM; percent for casein; n is reported assay count with independent unit unspecified.
missing_fields: Table 4 concentration-response range, point count and dilution series
Table 4 peptide exposure time, temperature, assay volume and exact medium composition
Exact control-ligand identity behind printed gGLP-1 amide label
Per-repeat raw curves and independent biological/technical unit definition
Contemporaneous paired design linking Example 12 and control summaries or Table 3
Human clinical endpoint, exposure, safety and trial effect estimate

experiment_cards.interpretation_limit: This is a separate engineered-cell assay condition for Example12, not a new independent drug project or a paired trial of the two assay conditions. Different Table3/Table4 EC50s do not by themselves establish albumin binding, clinical potency, weight-loss efficacy, safety or trial success probability. Table2 binding Ki, Table5 rat pharmacokinetics and Example1 mouse effects are excluded.
